description: This file defines memory regions, hardware register addresses, and structures for managing Intel ADSP memory components within the Zephyr RTOS, including SRAM, IMR, cache, and power management registers.

classes.name: ace_l2mcap
classes.description: Structure representing L2 memory capabilities with bit fields for different memory support features.

classes.name: ace_l2mm
classes.description: Structure representing L2 memory management registers.

classes.name: ace_hpsram_regs
classes.description: Structure for power gating and retention control of HP SRAM banks.

classes.name: ace_lpsram_regs
classes.description: Structure for power gating and retention control of LP SRAM banks.

methods.name: ace_hpsram_get_bank_count
methods.description: Returns the number of HP SRAM banks supported, reading from hardware register.

methods.name: ace_lpsram_get_bank_count
methods.description: Returns the number of LP SRAM banks supported, reading from hardware register.
